# Agent Plugins schema fixtures

`1.0.0/plugin.schema.json` and `1.0.0/mcp.schema.json` are unmodified copies from the published [Agent Plugins specification](https://github.com/agentplugins/agent-plugins-spec), version 1.0.0. The schema files are licensed under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`.

They are vendored so conformance tests remain deterministic and offline.
